decision: R1265 retain the stdcall prototype. The x86 redirector object references _call_ica_hw_interrupt@12; the generated VDMREDIR link explicitly aliases this to the raw call_ica_hw_interrupt import. NTVDM exports the public wrapper _mvdm_public_ica_interrupt@12, which invokes the internal cdecl ica_hw_interrupt. Restoring the default cdecl declaration changes callee cleanup as well as the requested symbol.
